seo.title: Data Safety | What Valam Collects, Shares and Protects | Valam
seo.description: A plain summary of Valam's data safety: what stays on your phone, what is collected only if you opt in, who it is shared with, how it is encrypted, and how to delete it.

title: Data safety
intro: A clear summary of what Valam collects, what it shares, how it is protected and how you can delete it. For the full legal wording, read the Privacy Policy.

highlights.title: Your ledger stays on your phone
highlights.body: Transactions, accounts, goals and chats with Mathi are stored in an encrypted vault on your device. We never receive them.

highlights.title: No ads, no tracking
highlights.body: No advertising, no third party analytics or tracking SDKs, and we never sell or rent your personal data.

highlights.title: No account needed
highlights.body: The free app works fully without signing in. An account exists only if you choose Plus, sync, shared groups or the free month.

highlights.title: Encrypted, with keys only you hold
highlights.body: Data is encrypted on the device and in transit. Because we do not hold your keys, we cannot read your data.

highlights.title: Delete any time
highlights.body: Delete your account and cloud data yourself in Settings. Server data is erased immediately.

highlights.title: Optional means optional
highlights.body: Sync, groups and cloud reasoning are off until you turn them on, and you can turn them off again whenever you like.

collected.title: What data is collected
collected.subtitle: Collected means sent off your device to us or a service provider. Everything else stays on your phone.
rows: Financial info (transactions, balances, budgets, loans, cards)
Stays encrypted on your phone. If you turn on sync or groups, it is sealed on your phone first, so we only hold data we cannot read.
Only if you sign in for Plus, sync, shared groups or the free month. Used to sign you in and let friends find you if you allow it.
User IDs (sign in ID, app user ID)
Used to sign you in and verify your subscription. Handled by Google Firebase and RevenueCat on our behalf.
Plus purchases are handled by Apple or Google. We only learn whether your subscription is active. We never see card details.
Mathi runs on your device by default. Chats stay encrypted on your phone.
A sanitised question and a summary of numbers go to a cloud language model. Transaction text and your own merchant and people names are removed first.
If you allow it, bank messages are read on your device at unlock to find transactions. They are not uploaded.
Processed on the device where supported. Optional.
Imports and backups happen on your phone. Backups are encrypted with your passphrase.
Kept only so we can reply to you or tell you about the launch.
Not collected. The app has no ads and no analytics SDKs.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.subtitle: We do not sell data. A small number of providers process data on our behalf, only to run optional features.

items.title: Google Firebase
items.body: Sign in, hosting of encrypted sync and group records, and cloud functions.

items.title: RevenueCat, Apple and Google
items.body: Subscriptions and purchases. They hold purchase records under their own policies.

items.title: Cloud language model provider
items.body: Only for optional Think harder requests, using sanitised input. We ask the provider not to use the content to train its models.

items.title: Apple iCloud or Google Drive
items.body: Optional sync into your own storage account. We cannot read what is stored there.

items.title: Hardware sealed master key
items.body: A random 256 bit key is sealed by the Secure Enclave on iPhone or the Keystore on Android, and released only after Face ID, fingerprint or PIN.

items.title: Encrypted on the device
items.body: Your database, attachments and chat history are encrypted with keys derived from the master key. Keys are wiped from memory when the app locks.

items.title: Encrypted backups
items.body: Backups are encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase. Restore them on a new phone.

items.title: End to end encrypted groups
items.body: Shared group entries are encrypted between members. Our servers hold encrypted events and the minimum identifiers needed to deliver them.

items.title: Recovery key
items.body: A recovery key shown once at setup is the only other way in. Lose it and your device access, and nobody, including us, can recover your data.

items.title: Privacy mode
items.body: Hide amounts with one tap when someone is looking over your shoulder.

permissions.title: App permissions
permissions.subtitle: Valam asks only when a feature needs it. The app works without the optional ones.
rows: Face ID, fingerprint or device PIN
Reading bank messages on your device at unlock.

retention.title: Keeping and deleting your data
items: Data on your phone stays until you delete it or remove the app.
Delete your account in the app (Settings, then Delete account) and the data our servers hold is erased immediately.
If you cannot open the app, email privacy@valam.io. After verifying it is you, we delete your data within 30 days.
Limited security and abuse logs are kept for up to 90 days. Purchase records are kept by Apple, Google and our subscription provider as the law requires.
Entries you added to a shared group stay with the other members, because their balances depend on them.

children.title: Children
children.body: Valam is not directed to children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them.

contact: Questions about data safety? Email privacy@valam.io and we will reply within 7 days.
